name: amarillo-argon-bridge
description: Windows-first Roblox Studio Amarillo plugin + local daemon inspired by Argon.

scripts.build: npm run build:runtime && npm run build:extension
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:runtime && npm run typecheck:extension && npm run typecheck:connection && npm run typecheck:scripts && npm run typecheck:tests
scripts.check: npm run build:scripts && npm run build && npm run build:tests && npm run typecheck && node scripts/check-js-syntax.js
scripts.package:vsix: npm run version:sync && npm run build && node scripts/package-vsix.js
scripts.test: npm run build:scripts && npm run build && npm run build:tests && node --test tests/*.test.js
scripts.test:ci: npm run check && npm test && npm run package:vsix
